    <div class="layout__main stack stack--xl">
      <section class="service" id="strategy" aria-labelledby="strategy-title">
        <span class="card__icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/></svg></span>
        <h2 class="section-title" id="strategy-title">Product strategy</h2>
        <p>Discovery research, stakeholder workshops and a roadmap tied to outcomes you can measure.</p>
        <ul class="check-list">
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Customer interviews and usability studies</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Opportunity mapping and prioritisation</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Success metrics and analytics plan</li>
        </ul>
      </section>
      <section class="service" id="design" aria-labelledby="design-title">
        <span class="card__icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 19 7-7 3 3-7 7zM18 13l-1.5-7.5L2 2l3.5 14.5L13 18z"/><path d="m2 2 7.59 7.59"/><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="2"/></svg></span>
        <h2 class="section-title" id="design-title">Design systems</h2>
        <p>A token-driven system your designers and developers share, documented and ready for any framework.</p>
        <ul class="check-list">
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Design tokens, themes and dark mode</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Component library with accessibility notes</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Governance and contribution model</li>
        </ul>
      </section>
      <section class="service" id="engineering" aria-labelledby="engineering-title">
        <span class="card__icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m16 18 6-6-6-6M8 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg></span>
        <h2 class="section-title" id="engineering-title">Engineering</h2>
        <p>Standards-based front ends that are fast, secure and easy to maintain, in your stack of choice.</p>
        <ul class="check-list">
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> ASP.NET Core, React, Next.js, Django and Laravel</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Performance budgets and Core Web Vitals</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Strict CSP and security reviews</li>
        </ul>
      </section>
      <section class="service" id="accessibility" aria-labelledby="accessibility-title">
        <span class="card__icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="4.5" r="1.5"/><path d="M5 8.5 12 10l7-1.5M12 10v4.5M12 14.5 9 21M12 14.5l3 6.5"/></svg></span>
        <h2 class="section-title" id="accessibility-title">Accessibility audits</h2>
        <p>Manual and automated WCAG 2.2 audits with prioritised fixes and team training.</p>
        <ul class="check-list">
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Screen reader and keyboard testing</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> VPAT and conformance reports</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Developer and designer training</li>
        </ul>
      </section>
      <section class="service" id="ai" aria-labelledby="ai-title">
        <span class="card__icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l1.9 5.1L19 10l-5.1 1.9L12 17l-1.9-5.1L5 10l5.1-1.9z"/><path d="M19 15l.8 2.2L22 18l-2.2.8L19 21l-.8-2.2L16 18l2.2-.8zM5 2l.6 1.4L7 4l-1.4.6L5 6l-.6-1.4L3 4l1.4-.6z"/></svg></span>
        <h2 class="section-title" id="ai-title">AI experiences</h2>
        <p>Chat assistants and agent workflows with interfaces people understand and trust.</p>
        <ul class="check-list">
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Conversation design and prompt strategy</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Streaming chat and agent UIs</li>
                <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg> Evaluation, safety and human handoff</li>
        </ul>
      </section>
      <section class="stack" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
        <h2 class="section-title" id="faq-title">Questions</h2>
        <div class="accordion">
          <details class="accordion__item" name="services-faq">
            <summary class="accordion__summary">How long does a typical project take? <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></summary>
            <div class="accordion__panel"><p>Most engagements run 6 to 16 weeks. We start with a two-week discovery sprint.</p></div>
          </details>
          <details class="accordion__item" name="services-faq">
            <summary class="accordion__summary">Do you work with our existing developers? <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></summary>
            <div class="accordion__panel"><p>Yes. We pair with your team and hand over documented, framework-agnostic code.</p></div>
          </details>
        </div>
        <p><a class="btn" href="contact.html">Discuss your project</a></p>
      </section>
    </div>
  </div>

  6. 06 Chat widget Shared partial
    src/layouts/partials/chat-widget.html
    Chat widget 
    <!-- Floating support assistant. Needs components/chat.css + main.js. -->
<div class="chat-widget" data-chat-widget>
  <button type="button" class="btn chat-widget__launcher" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="chat-widget-panel" data-chat-launcher hidden>
    <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg>
    <span>Ask Acme AI</span>
  </button>
  <div class="chat-widget__panel" id="chat-widget-panel" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="chat-widget-title" hidden>
    <section class="chat chat--widget" data-chat data-chat-persona="support" data-chat-storage="vr-chat-support">
      <header class="chat__header">
        <span class="avatar avatar--soft"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="8" width="18" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M12 8V4M8 2h8M9 13v2M15 13v2"/></svg></span>
        <div class="chat__heading">
          <h2 class="chat__title" id="chat-widget-title">Acme AI support</h2>
          <p class="chat__status">Usually replies instantly</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon btn--sm" data-chat-clear hidden>
          <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M23 4v6h-6M1 20v-6h6"/><path d="M3.51 9a9 9 0 0 1 14.85-3.36L23 10M1 14l4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 0 20.49 15"/></svg>
          <span class="visually-hidden">Start a new conversation</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon btn--sm" data-chat-close>
          <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/></svg>
          <span class="visually-hidden">Minimise chat</span>
        </button>
      </header>
      <div class="chat__log" role="log" aria-label="Conversation with Acme AI support" aria-live="off" tabindex="0" data-chat-log>
        <div class="chat__message chat__message--assistant">
          <div class="chat__bubble">
            <p>Hi! I can track orders, explain returns and shipping, or connect you with a person. What can I help with?</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chat__suggestions" data-chat-suggestions hidden>
        <button type="button" class="chip" data-chat-suggestion>Where is my order #1061?</button>
        <button type="button" class="chip" data-chat-suggestion>What is your return policy?</button>
        <button type="button" class="chip" data-chat-suggestion>Talk to a person</button>
      </div>
      <form class="chat__composer" action="../../templates/website/contact.html" method="get" data-chat-form>
        <label class="visually-hidden" for="chat-widget-input">Message Acme AI support</label>
        <textarea class="chat__input" id="chat-widget-input" name="message" rows="1" placeholder="Ask a question…" required data-chat-input></textarea>
        <div class="chat__actions">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn--icon btn--sm" data-chat-send>
            <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M22 2 11 13"/><path d="M22 2 15 22l-4-9-9-4z"/></svg>
            <span class="visually-hidden">Send message</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn--icon btn--sm btn--secondary" data-chat-stop hidden>
            <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/></svg>
            <span class="visually-hidden">Stop generating</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
      <p class="chat__disclaimer">Demo assistant with sample data. Answers may be inaccurate.</p>
    </section>
  </div>
</div>
  7. 07 Theme panel Shared partial
    src/layouts/partials/theme-panel.html
    Theme panel 
    <dialog class="dialog drawer" id="theme-panel" aria-labelledby="theme-panel-title" closedby="any">
  <div class="dialog__header">
    <h2 class="dialog__title" id="theme-panel-title">Customize theme</h2>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon" commandfor="theme-panel" command="close">
      <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
      <span class="visually-hidden">Close theme panel</span>
    </button>
  </div>
  <form class="dialog__body form" data-theme-customizer>
    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Mode</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="system"><span class="segmented__label">System</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="light"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M6.34 17.66l-1.41 1.41M19.07 4.93l-1.41 1.41"/></svg> Light</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="dark"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg> Dark</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Brand colour</legend>
      <div class="swatches">
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="indigo"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--indigo"></span> Indigo</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="teal"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--teal"></span> Teal</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="violet"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--violet"></span> Violet</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="rose"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--rose"></span> Rose</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="amber"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--amber"></span> Amber</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="slate"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--slate"></span> Slate</label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-custom-color">Or pick any brand colour</label>
      <p class="field__hint" id="theme-custom-hint">Shades are adjusted automatically to keep text readable in both themes.</p>
      <input class="color-input" id="theme-custom-color" name="custom" type="color" value="#2a4fcf" aria-describedby="theme-custom-hint">
    </div>

    <p class="text-sm text-muted" role="status" data-theme-contrast></p>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Density</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="compact"><span class="segmented__label">Compact</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="comfortable"><span class="segmented__label">Comfortable</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Corners</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="sharp"><span class="segmented__label">Sharp</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="round"><span class="segmented__label">Round</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-css-output">CSS for your project</label>
      <textarea class="textarea textarea--code" id="theme-css-output" readonly rows="8" data-theme-output></textarea>
    </div>

    <div class="form-actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm" data-copy data-copy-target="#theme-css-output" hidden><span data-copy-label>Copy CSS</span></button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm btn--ghost" data-theme-reset>Reset to defaults</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>
